Q2.title: Pre-Submission Questions for FDA
Q2.description: The substantive payload of the Q-Sub. Contains explicit, numbered questions the team wants FDA to answer before formal 510(k) filing — targeted, focused, and directly answerable rather than open-ended discussion prompts. Each question is scoped to a single decision and references the supporting materials elsewhere in the package.
Q2.why_important_in_project: For PP3500, the Q-Sub questions are the team's opportunity to de-risk the four highest-stakes regulatory decisions before filing K210345: (1) is PP3000 (K190567) an adequate predicate given the SaMD additions and connectivity expansion; (2) is the proposed PCCP envelope (drug library updates, firmware patches, predictive alarms within fixed risk profile) acceptable as scoped; (3) does the criticality carve-out (Ct*-tagged requirement subset for filing scope, deferred non-Ct* items for commercial-only V&V) align with FDA expectations for a Class II infusion pump; (4) how should the SaMD/SiMD/hardware combination be scoped under the Multiple Function Device guidance. Sharp questions here save weeks of post-filing back-and-forth.

Q5.title: Predicate Identification (PP3000 / K190567)
Q5.description: Identifies PP3000 (K190567) as the predicate device for the planned PP3500 510(k) with rationale for the predicate selection. Lighter than the full 510(k) Section 12 predicate comparison — establishes that PP3000 is the right anchor, but defers the detailed feature-by-feature comparison table to filing time. This Q-Sub-level version provides enough basis for FDA to engage on Q-1 (predicate adequacy).
Q5.why_important_in_project: Predicate selection is the single highest-stakes decision in a 510(k) substantial-equivalence pathway. If FDA disagrees with the choice of PP3000 at filing time, the team has wasted months. Validating PP3000 as predicate at the Q-Sub stage — specifically getting FDA comfortable that PP3500's SaMD / connectivity / AI-alarm additions don't disqualify PP3000 — is the most valuable Q-Sub outcome. This document tees up that question with sufficient predicate context (clearance number, product code, indications, key technological characteristics) without bogging down in the full SE table.
